description: REQ-002's edge cases prescribe two different degrade behaviors: a `verify-error` (RPC infrastructure failure) gets a narrate-only trace.jsonl line, while an `unconfirmed` signature (a definitive on-chain fact, per the spec text) is specified to have its reason "logged to stderr only". The FIND-007 fix in sol-trade/run.sh collapses BOTH cases (plus bad-args/no-delta) into the same trace.jsonl `sol-verify-failed` line via one uniform branch (`[ "$RSTATUS" != "recorded" ] && [ "$RSTATUS" != "duplicate" ]`), so an `unconfirmed` status now also gets a durable trace.jsonl entry beyond the spec's literal wording for that specific sub-case.
impact: No money-safety invariant is violated (earn-ledger.jsonl -- the GATE-0 profitability ledger -- is untouched either way, and no PROP-XXX proof obligation tests trace.jsonl-absence specifically for the unconfirmed sub-case). This is a STRICTER/more-auditable behavior than the spec's literal text requires for that one sub-case, not a functional regression or a money-safety gap. Non-blocking.
